name: Charges Per Transaction 5
definition: Provides information on the charges related to the payment transaction.

ChargesIdentification.name: Charges Identification
ChargesIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the charges information for reconciliation purpose.

TotalChargesPerTransaction.name: Total Charges Per Transaction
TotalChargesPerTransaction.definition: Total charges claimed for the transaction.

ChargesAccount.name: Charges Account
ChargesAccount.definition: Identifies the account that has been debited or credited for the charges, interest or other|adjustment(s).

ChargesAccountOwner.name: Charges Account Owner
ChargesAccountOwner.definition: Agent that owns the charges account.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the reason for the charges.

ChargesAccountTransactionOrRecord2Rule.definition: When Record/ChargesAccount is present or Record/ChargesAccountOwner is present then ChargesAccount must be absent and ChargesAccountOwner must be absent.

ChargesAccountTransactionOrRecord1Rule.definition: When ChargesAccount is present or ChargesAccountOwner is present then  Record/ChargesAccount must be absent and Record/ChargesAccountOwner must be absent.
